articles.description:
RT Mario Nawfal
SOLAR PANELS THAT OUTLIVE YOUR MORTGAGE: WHY TODAY'S TECH LASTS 40+ YEARS
Solar panels don’t just “pay for themselves” - they stick around.
Glass-on-glass designs, lower annual efficiency loss (~0.4%), and no moving parts mean today’s panels can easily last 40–50 years with minimal upkeep.
Longer lifespan = lower energy costs, fewer replacements, and more time before we deal with panel waste.
The twist? You might swap phones 20 times before your roof even thinks about quitting.

RT Mario Nawfal
🇺🇸 "TESLA ROTATED MY TIRES IN MY DRIVEWAY — AND I’M NEVER GOING BACK"
Melissa Zatz didn’t expect to fall for her Tesla Model Y — but between the smooth tech, sleek design, and now mobile service, she’s officially obsessed.
When it came time for a tire rotation, Tesla didn’t ask her to carve hours out of her week — they sent a tech named Edwardo to her home. 
He showed up in a Model 3, handled the job with precision, and even checked tire pressure and cameras.
For a multitasking mom buried in laundry, camp lists, and dinner prep, the ability to knock out car maintenance without leaving the house was a game-changer.
Forget charging — it’s this kind of white-glove convenience that really puts Tesla in its own category.
Source: Zatz Not Funny!
